text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from our outing,
when we visited a CD shop...

"Close Encounter of the Third Kind"...
The call sign is "MSIC," right?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Universe-san.
choice_data_list: Fancy meeting you in a place like this.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Sphira...
Neo Universe is currently "drifting"...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
“Scanning” the melody of memories proves difficult...
The “object of search” remains unconfirmed...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Can't find the music you're looking for?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative. Title and lyrics “unknown”...
Just like “interstellar dust”, isn't it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"To think there's so little information...
It must be quite difficult to track down the music you're looking for."
choice_data_list: I hope we can find some kind of clue...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Nn... "Melody" is "AVG".
If we are to reproduce it... like this, right.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...
That melody—
choice_data_list: Huh, could it be that you figured it out!?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...It's a song by an overseas instrumental band.
I listen to them sometimes.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Big Bang"...!
Neo Universe wants to know more.
...Will you give me "guidance"?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: …………――Over here.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Led by Admire Groove, we arrive at the listening station. Listening to the audio track, Neo Universe—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Sphira...!
An alternative "SOND"—without vocal cords—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"It's Neo Universe's 'sought object.'
...~~♪"

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
A cool melody is 'E.G'...
Hehe, 'stylish,' isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
This band on "MSIC"...
Is it Admire Groove's "favorite"?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: …………Not really.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Without any vocals, it's just easier to listen to than other music.
That's all.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"I see.
...Neo Universe 'likes'
progressive rock."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Prog rock is like the sound of the universe.
It lets me 'sense' the 'sparkle.'"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Alternative instrumentals have a "sparkle" to them, too.
Hehe... my body's "swaying" all on its own.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For example, during lunch breaks or those brief moments after school.
I feel like I occasionally spot her listening to music with earphones.
choice_data_list: (I wonder if she's listening to the instrumental too...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: If Admire Groove has music she likes, I'd like to know more. But acting overly familiar isn't something she would want...
choice_data_list: Maybe I'll try listening to this band's songs too.
Maybe I'll give this band's songs a listen too.
I'm glad I could be of help

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: If Admire Groove has music she likes, I'd like to know more. But acting overly familiar isn't something she would want...
choice_data_list: Maybe I'll try listening to this band's songs too.
Maybe I'll give this band's songs a listen too.
I'm glad I could be of help

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I think you should do as you like.
You can listen to it on subscription services too.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I look forward to returning. With this "MSIC"...
I will do plenty of "FELT".

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...It's just that
we happened to share the same goal.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Even so,
Admire Groove 'guided' us.
...That's a 'connection,' isn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Neo Universe will do 'communicate.'
...'Thank you.'"

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Ngh, ...I don't need your gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I look forward to returning. With this "MSIC"...
I will do plenty of "FELT".

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Ah, this is—an encounter with "serendipity."
A true "Big Bang."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe suddenly stares at a poster
put up on a shop.
Depicted upon it is—
choice_data_list: Ah, are you the band from earlier!?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
An urgent visit to Japan... So they're "touching down" in Japan, huh.
Sounds like they'll be performing a "melody" live.
choice_data_list: Since we have the chance, wanna go take a look?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: —No, I refuse.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
The audio tracks alone are enough.
I have no interest... in anything else.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
…………
Yes. Neo Universe "respects" that.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
In that case, our "dialogue" is over...
Even the audio source is "grooving".

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, that's right.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Admire Groove answers,
looking somewhat relieved...
